# Pull Request

## Work Order

Link to the work order or GitHub issue this PR implements:

## Spec

Link to the spec under `.openspec/specs/` for this change:

## Summary

A brief summary of what this PR changes and why.

## Evidence Checklist

Please provide evidence that this change is complete and correct:

- [ ] **Tests run and result**: All tests pass (provide output or link)
- [ ] **Run report**: For factory executed work, attach or link the run report
- [ ] **Rendered evidence**: For visual changes, include screenshots or recordings
- [ ] **Documentation**: Updated relevant documentation (README, docs/, brain/)
- [ ] **Changelog**: Updated CHANGELOG.md if this project maintains one

## Reviewer Notes

The author never approves their own work. Reviewer stations and the human gate decide if this change merges.

If this PR carries risk hints (auth, payments, data deletion, production deploy, secrets, publishing), it will stop at the human gate for review before merging.
